content.short: PublicNode provides fast, free, and privacy-focused RPC endpoints for seamless Web3 access.
content.description: PublicNode streamlines access to blockchains by delivering free, reliable, high-speed connections to the mainnets and testnets of nearly 100 networks. The service handles more than 5 billion requests in a 24-hour window and is continually growing, underscoring its ability to support substantial blockchain activity. PublicNode also provides regularly updated Snapshots for over 100 blockchains, enabling users to initialize or restore nodes using pre-synced blockchain data.
